digest.component_or_area: LLM usage-log summarization and cost reporting
propositions: usage-log rows must record model, provider, and UTC ISO timestamp in addition to existing token fields
summarize must compute per-row and per-op estimated cost using genai-prices when available, with LookupError and other exceptions caught and marked unpriced without raising
genai-prices pricing must be optional with graceful fallback: absent package prints 'unavailable (install rebar[pricing])' and exits 0; present but failing pricing logs WARNING and marks row unpriced
runner.py must pass model and inferred provider to usage_log.record() at its call site
summarize output must include per-op cost column and per-model rollup table with 'est. cost' label and note of excluded unpriced calls
